title: Project-Level Risk Assessment
description: Assesses project-level risks across timeline, safety, resource, and scientific dimensions.

steps.prompt: Assess timeline and schedule risks for this project: missed milestones, iteration velocity, blocked dependencies, and deadline pressure. Rate from 1 (low) to 5 (high) and list mitigations.
Evaluate overall project safety risks: aggregate hazard exposure, unmitigated risks from experiments, and regulatory compliance gaps. Rate from 1 to 5 with mitigations.
Assess resource risks: personnel availability, equipment bottlenecks, budget overrun risk, and supply chain concerns. Rate from 1 to 5 with mitigations.
Evaluate scientific and technical risks: hypothesis validity, reproducibility concerns, data quality issues, and divergence from prior literature. Rate from 1 to 5 with mitigations.
